Residents Buy from the Holy Caravan If possible, villagers will try to buy goods directly from the Holy Caravan, if those goods are cheaper and more accessible there than on the local market. Luxury resources such as Meat or Flavorful Ale will only be bought if villagers have saved a significant amount of {very_rich_threshold} or if they lack other food or alcohol. Lords can buy Holy Rings from the caravan if they have enough Gold. Hint: That money could be yours. Study the “Internal Trade” knowledge to build your own Market.

Followers
Lords who consider the politician a friend (their opinion of him is above <green>+25</green>), but who are not friends of your king or another politician.

$ These lords, along with the warriors loyal to them, will support the politician’s rebellion in case of conflict with your king.  
$ If the politician is eliminated, they will become strongly hostile toward your king.

No Politicians
The modifier disables the appearance of politicians – rival lords on your local map who may compete for the crown.

This is an important part of the game, so disable this option only if you are sure about what you're doing."

Bishop donated to a politician
{soul_uuid_iniciator} made a donation to {soul_uuid_target} for political activity.

Perhaps the church decided to back him because his relationship with {soul_uuid_target} is better than with your ruler.

Grant the title of Priest
The King turns the character over to the <hint=hint_sofia_cult>Church</hint>.

The Church is always happy whenever sacrifices are made in the name of Mother Sophia, and thus it will be eternally grateful:
$ Relations with the <hint=hint_relations_matriarch>Matriarch</hint>: <green>{mat_rel}</green>
$ Gift from the Matriarch: <hint=hint_resource_gold>{amount}</hint>

The character will leave your province forever.

Arm Your Squad Lords and knights choose their own weapons from your storage, while warriors can be armed manually. Warriors take weapons and armor in turn. When hovering over a weapon, the next warrior to receive it will be highlighted. 1. Click the axe icon in the menu to arm all warriors. 2. Finish by clicking Create at the bottom of the menu.

Commander Equipment
Lords and knights choose their own equipment from your storage.

Auto-Learning
If enabled, after completing the study of one knowledge, the lord will automatically begin studying another until all are mastered.

The order of study is from simple to complex, with economic knowledge prioritized first.
